text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...It's a bizarre heat.

That happened when we stopped by
the course earlier this morning—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
The track conditions are just as you said.
Doesn't seem like there'll be any issues.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Narita Brian.
Good luck in today's race!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If Rice Shower gets serious, it's gonna be bad!
They don't call her the "Assassin" for nothing,
so don't you dare let your guard down!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
My McQueen was also taken by her...
But make sure you don't lose, okay!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...That was something altogether different from cheering.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Worry not.
I am not so fragile.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch... How far do you plan on seeing me off?
Hurry up and go to the stands or the staff seats—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it... Rice.
Hang in there... Rice...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower, huh.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I-I am fine...
So please, pay me no mind..."
However, Rice Shower's knees were shaking so violently that it looked difficult for her to even stand up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I apologize for that... Here, let me lend a hand.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Please don't! If you get close to Rice...
...you'll just end up cursed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
They say bad things happen whenever I'm around.
Everyone thinks so too. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for causing you trouble.
I'm fine now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Even though your knees are shaking?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When someone wins, someone else loses.
To someone, that winner is... a villain to be defeated.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Becoming someone who hurts others...
is scary, sad, and awful. But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice doesn't want to run away
from racing, though...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because there are people who find joy in my running...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Assassin" is a title bestowed only upon
those who understand what they must accomplish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Rarely does one find someone with such strong core conviction.
...I, too, shall give it everything I have.
